method.advised: Per advice (backtestTrade excluded, algo=advisor folder id): leg unit pnl = sign*(avgExitPrice-entryPrice); advised_pnl = sum(maxLots*multiplier*quantity*unit) over legs of advices where ck matched >=1 leg (equals advice.pnl; mismatches counted). advised_pnl_1lot uses 1 lot. advised_pnl_all_advices = every advice in cache.
method.dhan: attr.py FIFO round trips per contract; leftovers on expired contracts settled at 0; tags COPIER/SPREAD/MARGIN_SOLO/NAKED as attr.py (round trip tagged by its opening fill).
method.join: Each round trip joins by its opening fill to an advice leg with same (NIFTY, expiry, strike, cp, side) and same IST entry date, createdAt within 30 min of the fill; best = min(0.2*minutes + 20*relative entry-price gap). Monthly symbols map to the Dhan expiry in the last week of that month.
method.charges: attr.py per-order model (Rs20 brokerage split per order, STT, exch, SEBI, stamp, 18% GST) x calibration ratio to the Dhan footer; allocated to round trips by qty share of the opening and closing fills; charges on still-open Dec qty go to unmatched.
method.decomposition: ck_net - advised_pnl = slippage + topup_effect + missed_leg_effect - ck_charges (gap_check ~0). Per matched leg: slippage = ck_gross - ck_qty*advice_unit; topup_effect = (ck_qty - stratzy_qty)*advice_unit (negative if ck sized below Stratzy); missed_leg_effect = -stratzy_qty*advice_unit for advice legs ck never traded (e.g. a hedge leg).
method.topup_multiple: ck_qty_mult = ck matched leg qty / Stratzy qty (maxLots*multiplier) over matched legs.

caveats: VM unreachable (Twingate/adaptive down); used local data/recorder/stratzy-trades.jsonl copy (42 rows, Sep 24-28 only) and its attrib has algo=None/source=fingerprint on all rows, so contract-level join only.
Advice cache ends 2026-10-23; Dhan trips opened later cannot match.
Several algos often open the same contract in the same minute; the join picks the nearest advice by time then entry price, so per-algo splits can swap between simultaneous algos.
ck qty is not Stratzy-only: SPREAD/MARGIN_SOLO/NAKED fills include ck manual trades that happen to share a contract-day with an advice.
NIFTY only (no SENSEX fills in Dhan); MCX/CNC excluded as in attr.py.
Per-tag net in this file allocates charges to the opening-fill tag of each round trip; attribution.json allocates by fill tag, so only gross and total net compare exactly.
